    REAL CONTROLS HAVE DIFFERENT JOBS

    A hand controller is not a steering wheel.

    The LM’s Attitude Controller Assembly commands attitude changes through the guidance/control system. The Thrust/Translation Controller Assembly handles translation and, in applicable modes, engine thrust. A new direction of thrust changes velocity over time; turning the spacecraft alone does not turn its orbit.

    Inspect Apollo hand controls ↗
    THREE DIFFERENT COMPUTER RESPONSIBILITIES

    The right computer, at the right time.

    Saturn’s launch vehicle computer controls the normal TLI burn. Columbia’s CMC runs Comanche; Eagle’s LGC runs Luminary. Crew switches, docking hardware and surface work also require human action. “Every action controlled by AGC” would misrepresent the mission.
